reason: As a skeptical director, I'd notice that B goes beyond the facts in places: it says each prescription loses money when $1.80 is an average, says none of the pharmacies can make up the loss on brand-name drugs, and implies a fifth of their orders are filled below cost. A states the same facts plainly, including the 20-mile distance to a chain store that answers my point about access, so I'd find it more credible and more likely to act on.
